scope: Adds the independently validated Lebl learning capability for B70/C10/C20/C50, twelve learner/teacher/terminology tools and its unchanged 41-entry reproducible source packet. The 18 validated adapter roles and 22 without bindings do not prove full backend completion. No new corpus translation or owner control mutation. All 40 course roles now expose identified original-source links prominently in both interface languages, preserving actual source languages and existing primary readers. Offline effective-catalog serialization is checked exhaustively against online data. English mirroring remains incomplete. Existing reader additions: complete D20 companion HTML and offline-capable combined textbook/companion ZIP; complete B10 HTML ZIP explicitly requiring internet for MathJax and online features. Added resources remain Indonesian in both locales. Primary readers and PDFs remain unchanged. Bilingual learner interface: paired offline language navigation and history-rejection resilience; explicit standalone fallback, progress-transfer guidance, and discoverable ZIP entry. All 40 course identities, 83 prerequisite edges and 39 English main-resource bindings are preserved. No translation or corpus mutation; new backend admission is limited to the audit-owned Lebl capability. Existing native B80 packet and translated English editions remain unchanged.
